subject: GreenWave VM: SAST/DAST, SBOM & Patch SLA clarifications
messages:
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@greenwave.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenWave Security Team <security@greenwave.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: VM questionnaire — initial set and a couple clarifications

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Attached is GreenWave's standard vulnerability management / SBOM / pen-test questionnaire — we call it the VM Evidence Pack. We need completed answers and supporting evidence for SAST/DAST coverage, patching SLAs, and your last full pen test summary.

Two clarifications up front that would help triage:
- We need to confirm whether you perform SAST during CI (pre-merge) or only as a scheduled eng-process run.
- For third-party CVE patching, what are your SLA buckets (Critical/P1, High/P2, Medium/P3) and measurable timelines?

Can you confirm a turnaround we can expect? Our procurement window is tight and we need this by end of next week if possible.

Thanks,
Emma Jones
Security Analyst, GreenWave Financial
Attachments: GW_VM_Questionnaire.pdf
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@greenwave.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VM questionnaire — initial set and a couple clarifications

Emma — thanks, received the pack. We're starting an internal review now and will return a consolidated response with evidence. Quick answers to your clarifications:

- SAST: We run a mixed model. Our engineering teams run linters and lightweight SAST checks in CI for PR gating (pre-merge). In addition, we run a centralized, scheduled full SAST (Semgrep + commercial ruleset) weekly on protected branches.

- Patch SLAs: We operate tiered response windows: Critical (0–72 hours triage, mitigation plan within 72h, hotfix within 7 days), High (triage within 72h, remediation plan within 14 days), Medium/Low (planning in next sprint, typically 30–90 days depending on impact). We'll include a table with measured MTTR/MTTR metrics from the last 12 months.

I’m copying Neha (Security) and Aditya (Runtime) to attach evidence (SBOM extract, recent pen-test summary, and our patching runbook). Can we aim to deliver the first pass by EOD Thursday 2026-06-18?

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:23:00 -0700
Subject: FW: VM questionnaire — evidence items we should attach

Dylan — forwarding Emma's note. I pulled the following artifacts that will help:

1) redwood-sbom-inventory-2026-06.csv — SBOM export for the hosted control plane and runtime. Fields: component,name,version,license,type,sha256
2) penetration-summary-2025.pdf — executive summary from third-party pen test (Nov 2025) with remediation status matrix
3) gw-vm-questionnaire-answers-draft.docx — our draft answers; will convert to PDF for submission.

Notes on coverage:
- DAST: we run authenticated DAST scans on production-like staging per major release (approx monthly for major services) + targeted scans on canary. We also run passive runtime monitoring (RASP-style telemetry) for runtime indicators.
- Evidence gaps: we lack a consolidated per-dependency remediation timeline in the CSV; I'll add a mapping table showing CVE -> patch date (where available).

I’ll assemble and upload to the Drive folder and attach to the outbound.

—Neha
Staff Security Engineer
From: Emma Jones <emma.jones@greenwave.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenWave Security Team <security@greenwave.com>, Carlos Mendez <carlos.mendez@greenwave.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: VM questionnaire — initial set and a couple clarifications

Thanks — that looks helpful. A couple of follow-ups from our side:

- For SAST, can you confirm which rule sets you use (open-source vs commercial) and whether false-positive suppression is tracked? We need evidence that security findings are either triaged to owners or accepted with compensating controls.
- For patch SLAs, GreenWave will need a table tying CVE severity to actual median time-to-remediate across the last 12 months. Do you have that?

Also — are there any hosted components that accept uploaded customer data where SBOM coverage is incomplete? We have a strict procurement requirement that customer-provided code uploads must be covered by SBOM review.

Best,
Emma
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@greenwave.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Jun 2026 09:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VM questionnaire — initial set and a couple clarifications

Emma — quick technical clarifications inline: 

- SAST toolchain: we use a hybrid stack: Semgrep (OSS) for fast rule-writing, supplemented by a commercial SAST provider (licensed rules) for deeper dataflow analysis on core services. Findings are tracked in Jira with automated triage tags; suppressions are documented with root-cause notes and reviewed quarterly. We will extract an examples list showing suppression justification and owner assignment.

- Patch SLA metrics: attached is an exported table (redwood-patch-metrics-Q2-2026.csv) with median time-to-remediate by severity for the prior 12 months (Critical: 28 hours median triage-to-fix, High: 6 days, Medium: 22 days). We'll include methodology notes about detection-to-deployment window.

- SBOM coverage: customer-uploaded artifacts are isolated to a processing service running in a dedicated VPC; we generate an SBOM snapshot on ingest and surface high-risk components to the same patch workflow. There are a small number (<1%) of legacy connectors where we have manual review steps — we’ll call those out in the questionnaire and propose compensating controls.

Attaching: redwood-sbom-inventory-2026-06.csv; penetration-summary-2025.pdf; redwood-patch-metrics-Q2-2026.csv

—Aditya
Sr. Manager, Runtime Security
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@greenwave.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VM questionnaire — delivery and next steps

Emma — attaching the completed VM Evidence Pack (PDF) and the SBOM extract. Highlights:

- Enclosed table: measured median remediation times (12-month lookback) + methodology notes 
- SAST/DAST: toolchain and triage process documented; example Jira issues exported as evidence of fix ownership 
- Pen-test: executive summary with status of remediation; full report available under NDA if needed
- SBOM: CSV includes per-component hashes and a column showing remediation status / planned update windows for any components with open CVEs.

Next steps: please confirm receipt. If GreenWave needs the full pen-test report we can open an NDA and share the full artifact; otherwise the executive summary should be enough to move forward for procurement. Happy to hop on a 30-min call to walk through the artifacts.

Best,
Dylan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Attachments: GW_VM_Answers_20260618.pdf, redwood-sbom-inventory-2026-06.csv
